## Introduction

Make the scatter plots for the effect size. Show the anti-correlation of effect size between normal2mci vs other dementia categories.

## Load the data

### Effect size in long format

```{r}
# Derive the long-format DMP effect sizes from the annotated association table
source(here("custom_func/select_sig_cg.R"))
source(here("custom_func/build_dmp_long_effect_size.R"))

es <-
  read_rds(here("data/upon_request/annotated_asso_wide.rds")) |>
  select_sig_cg(8) |>
  build_dmp_long_effect_size() |>
  # Remove stable_mci
  dplyr::filter(demcat != "stable_mci") |>
  # Relevel demcat
  dplyr::mutate(demcat = forcats::fct_relevel(demcat, "prev", "normal2incid", "mci2incid", "normal2mci"))

glimpse(es)
```

```{r}
source(here("custom_func/display_scientific_notation.R"))

display_scientific_notation(1e-8)
```

## Make a data preparation function

This function will accept a data tibble, filter out the outliers, modify pval_cutoff,and calculate the correlation between two dementia categories.

```{r}
#| output: false

# Create a function
effect_size_for_scatter_plot <- function(.data, demcat_of_interest = normal2incid) {
  .data |>
    # Calculate the correlation between two dementia categories and create a label
    mutate(
      .by = demcat,
      cor_estimate = cor.test(es, {{demcat_of_interest}}, method = "spearman")$estimate,
      cor_pval = cor.test(es, {{demcat_of_interest}}, method = "spearman")$p.value %>% display_scientific_notation(),
      # cor_label = sprintf("r = %0.2f; p = %0.0f", cor, cor_pval)
      # cor_label = glue(
        # "atop(paste(phantom(p)~'r = {scales::label_number(style_negative='hyphen', accuracy=0.01)(cor)}'), paste(phantom(r)~'p = {round(cor_pval, 3)}'))"
      # )
      cor_estimate_label = glue("italic(r) == ~{round(cor_estimate, 2)}"),
      cor_pval_label = glue("italic(P) == ~{cor_pval}")
    )
}

# Test the function
es |>
  effect_size_for_scatter_plot(
    demcat_of_interest = prev
  ) |>
  glimpse()

```


## Make a plotting function

This function will accept a data tibble and plot a scatter plot of the effect size of two dementia categories.

```{r}
#| label: plotting-function
#| output: false

# Create a function
make_effect_size_scatter_plot <- function(.data, demcat_of_interest = "prev", size = 2, ...) {
  .data |>
    ggplot(aes(x = .data[[demcat_of_interest]], y = es)) +
    geom_point(size = 0.3, color = "grey30") +
    geom_smooth(formula = y ~ x, method = "lm", se = FALSE, linewidth = 0.6) +
    # Show the correlation at the top left corner
    geom_text( aes(label = cor_estimate_label), x = I(0.05), y = I(0.95), hjust = 0, vjust = 0.5, color = "darkred", family = "Source Sans Pro", fontface = "plain", parse = TRUE, size = size)  +
    geom_text( aes(label = cor_pval_label), x = I(0.05), y = I(0.87), hjust = 0, vjust = 0.5, color = "darkred", family = "Source Sans Pro", fontface = "plain", parse = TRUE, size = size) +
    facet_wrap(vars(demcat), nrow = 1, scales = "free") +
    # Show a light gray dashed line at x = 0 and y = 0
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray") +
    labs(x = glue("{dc}", dc = if (demcat_of_interest == "prev") "Prevalent dementia" else glue("{demcat_of_interest} transition")), y = "Other transitions")
}

# Test the function
es |>
  filter(demcat != "prev") |> 
  filter(! (demcat == "mci2incid" & es < -0.4)) |> 
  filter(! (demcat == "normal2mci" & es < -0.3)) |> 
  effect_size_for_scatter_plot(
    demcat_of_interest = prev
  ) |>
  make_effect_size_scatter_plot(demcat_of_interest = "prev", size = 2) 

```

## Initialize a list to store the scatter plots

```{r}
#| output: false

# For main figures
scatter_DMP_main <- list()
# For supplementary figures
scatter_DMP_suppl <- list()
```

## Prevelant dementia vs other dementia categories

```{r}
#| label: fig-prevalent-vs-other-categories
#| figure.width: 10
#| figure.height: 6

data_for_prev_plot <- 
  es |>
  filter(demcat != "prev") |> 
  filter(! (demcat == "mci2incid" & es < -0.4)) |> 
  filter(! (demcat == "normal2mci" & es < -0.3)) |>
  effect_size_for_scatter_plot(
    demcat_of_interest = prev
  )

scatter_DMP_main$prev <- 
  data_for_prev_plot |>
  make_effect_size_scatter_plot(demcat_of_interest = "prev", size = 3)

scatter_DMP_suppl$prev <-
  data_for_prev_plot |>
  make_effect_size_scatter_plot(demcat_of_interest = "prev", size = 4)

scatter_DMP_main$prev
scatter_DMP_suppl$prev
```

## mci2incid vs other dementia categories

```{r}
#| label: fig-mci2incid-vs-other-categories
#| figure.width: 10
#| figure.height: 6

data_for_mci2incid_plot <- 
  es |>
  filter(demcat != "mci2incid") |> 
  filter(! (demcat == "normal2mci" & es < -0.3)) |> 
  filter(mci2incid > -0.4) |>
  effect_size_for_scatter_plot(
    demcat_of_interest = mci2incid
  )

scatter_DMP_main$mci2incid <- 
  data_for_mci2incid_plot |>
  make_effect_size_scatter_plot(demcat_of_interest = "mci2incid", size = 3)

scatter_DMP_suppl$mci2incid <-
  data_for_mci2incid_plot |>
  make_effect_size_scatter_plot(demcat_of_interest = "mci2incid", size = 4)

scatter_DMP_suppl$mci2incid
```

## normal2incid vs other dementia categories

```{r}
#| label: fig-normal2incid-vs-other-categories
#| figure.width: 10
#| figure.height: 6

data_for_normal2incid_plot <-

scatter_DMP_main$normal2incid <-

scatter_DMP_suppl$normal2incid <-

scatter_DMP_suppl$normal2incid
```
